label: EXCLUDED_FORMAT_FIXTURE
exclusion_policy: All families, source/template IDs, renderings and descendants are permanently excluded from confirmatory training and final tests. These are formatting diagnostics only.
compatibility: Gold fields match pilot_dataset; this 12-family excluded fixture container is not an accepted Test 1 pilot dataset or a GPU-smoke input adapter.
borrowing_policy: Unreviewed fixture phrasing: R permits standard unit symbols and mathematical variables; C includes productive English relations. Human language review is still required.

E.text: An exhibit rents 7 small display plates at INR 43 each and pays an INR 29 handling fee. What is the total charge in INR?

R.text: Ek pradarshani mein 7 chhoti numaishi thaaliyan kiraye par li jaati hain. Har thaali ka kiraya 43 rupaye hai. Iske alaava poore order par sirf ek baar 29 rupaye sambhalne ka shulk lagta hai. Kul kitne rupaye dene honge?

C.text: Pradarshani ke liye 7 display plates kiraye par li hain. Each plate costs INR 43, and the handling fee adds INR 29. Kul charge kitna hai?

E.text: A community observatory has INR 1,32,400 in a repair fund. A fundraiser adds INR 8,750. How much is now in the fund, in INR?

R.text: Ek samudaayik vedhshala ki marammat ke kosh mein 1,32,400 rupaye hain. Chanda jama karne se 8,750 rupaye aur milte hain. Ab kosh mein kul kitne rupaye hain?

C.text: Vedhshala ke repair fund mein INR 1,32,400 hain. The fundraiser adds INR 8,750 to this fund. Ab total amount kitna hai?
